Name: Traditional Ukrainian Food
Author: Sh1ryUwu
Description:
This mod introduces a traveling chef who arrives at the tide pools docks (beach area that unlocks after fixing bridge near Eliot house) every Friday starting from the second year (you will get mail). The chef's shop always offers three random dishes from the game and one exclusive dish from the mod. Additionally, on specific days of any month, you can purchase unique recipes:
[list]
[*][b]5th:[/b] Borscht and Pampushky
[*][b]12th:[/b] Potato Varenyky and Benderyky
[*][b]19th:[/b] Cabbage Varenyky and Uzvar
[*][b]26th:[/b] Cherry Varenyky and Kompot
[*][b]Winter:[/b] The recipe for Kutya becomes available
[/list]
This mod also adds new crafting options for the keg and preserves jar:
[list]
[*]Place milk in a preserves jar to make sour cream in one day.
[*]Place bread in a keg to brew kvass in three days.
[/list]
For the Ukrainian translation, you'll need the Ukrainian Localization mod.
